LED BACKLIGHTING · JDL-SMB-24

24V Dual-CCT LED Backlight Bars for Stretch Ceilings JDL-SMB-24

ELVARO’s 24V LED bars for stretch ceilings are designed to backlight translucent stretch membranes. Each LED is fitted with a high-transmittance lens to spread light behind the membrane.

OverviewSpecificationsApplications

LED light bars for backlighting translucent surfaces

The dual-CCT version uses Sanan LED chips rated at 1 W per LED on a 1.0 mm PCB and delivers a color rendering index of Ra 95 or higher. For project selection, share your ceiling dimensions, the available depth behind the membrane, and your target color temperatures. Contact ELVARO for the datasheet and help selecting a configuration.
